values.description: You strike a creature where it already hurts. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target has already taken any damage since the end of your last turn, double the damage you deal.

You send forth a heap of powerful snow to pummel a creature. Make a ranged attack on a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target has dealt any damage to you since the end of your last turn, double the damage you deal.

You send a harsh blast of salt water at a creature. Make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target has less that 50% of its max HP, double the damage dealt.
You shoot a series of quickly moving bubbles at a target. Make three ranged attacks, doing {dice} {type} damage on each successful hit.
You pump yourself up, increasing your adrenaline. For the next minute, choose to add +1 to your attack rolls OR +1 to AC. This move can be stacked to a maximum of +5 of the initial choice.

You stir up a massive storm of sharp diamonds in a 30 foot radius, centered on a point in range. When a creature enters the area for the first time on their turn, or begins their turn inside the area, they take {dice} {type} damage. The Diamond Storm lasts for 3 rounds. When you activate this move, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, your AC is increased by 2 while the Diamond Storm is active.

values.name: Double Team
values.description:
You create a duplicate image of yourself, 5 feet beside you. The image mimics you and attempt to fool your opponents into attacking it, instead.

When subject to any move (attack or saving throw / damaging or non-damaging) with an area of effect of 5 feet wide or less, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, the image absorbs the damage and/or effects of the attack and disappears. Creatures with Truesight bypass the effect of this move. If grappled or restrained by a creature while Double Team is active, Double Team has no effect. (Examples that would trigger the roll include Tackle, Thunder Wave, Rock Slide, etc.)
values.optional:
When this move is used again before the duplicate is consumed, an additional duplicate is created, up to a maximum of three duplicates.

With two duplicates, the attacker must roll a 5 or 6 on a d6 to hit the target. With three duplicates, the attacker must roll a 7 or 8 on a d8.

values.description: You perform a mystical dance, pumping yourself up. For the duration, double your proficiency bonus when making an attack.

You release a series of moving flames that dance around a target. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. as the flames swirl around it. As long as you maintain concentration, the target takes an additional 1d8 {type} damage at the end of each of its next three turns.

You flail about with a wild strike that increases in power the more injured you are. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you are below 50% of your maximum health, double the damage. If you are at 10% or below of your maximum health, triple the damage instead. The multiplier for this attack occurs before the multiplier for resistances or vulnerabilities.

You can use a bonus action on your turn to choose one ally other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can hear you. That ally can add a d6 to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes within the next 10 minutes, before the result of the roll is called by the DM. An ally being helped can only have one d6 available at a time.

You summon an infestation of tiny insects to attack a creature for multiple turns. Make a ranged attack on a target. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and becomes infested with swarming bugs. As long as you maintain concentration, the target takes an additional 1d8 {type} damage at the end of each of its next three turns.

You latch onto a foe, never to let go. Make a melee attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

On a hit, you grapple the target. On your turn, you may activate this move against a target grappled this way to deal {dice} {type} damage. This move can grapple targets up to two sizes larger than you.
When you are subject to a ranged attack, use your reaction to take half the damage dealt now and on any ranged attack that targets you until the beginning of your next turn.
When you are subject to a melee attack, use your reaction to take half the damage dealt now and on any melee attack that targets you until the beginning of your next turn.

You unleash an all out attack that is stronger the less HP you have. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you are below 50% of your maximum health, double the damage. If you are at 10% or below of your maximum health, triple the damage instead. The multiplier for this attack occurs before the multiplier for resistances or vulnerabilities.

Large boulders appear above a target creature in range, crashing down on top of them. The target must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage and falling prone on a failed save, and half as much without falling prone on a success.

You land on the ground to rest your body. When activated, your flying speed decreases to zero, and you lose your flying type for as long as you remain on the ground. At the beginning of your next turn, if you have not left the ground, recover {dice} hit points.
You strike with a sharp claw made from shadows in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This moves scores a critical hit on natural attack rolls of 19 and 20.
This move is usable while Asleep, and only while Asleep. Create a harsh noise that damages all creatures within range for {dice} {type} damage.

The earth moves beneath a target’s feet as sharp stone pierce through the ground underneath them. Creatures in a 10 foot radius centered on a point you choose in range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a save.

values.name: Swords Dance
values.description: When you activate this move, a sword appears and dances around you, increasing your AC by 1. As a bonus action on a future turn, you may drop concentration to release this sword and roll a ranged attack at a target within 30 feet of you, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.
values.higherLevels: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5. At level 10, you can now create two swords for +2 to AC and two ranged attacks. At level 17, the damage dice for each sword increases to 3d8.

values.description: You disappear from view and reappear at an unoccupied point within range. In wild creature battles, this move can be activated to automatically count as a single success in a group DEX check to run away.
